description: The most relevant number of the problem "biased information" of the start page ranking and the potential solution. The concept paper gives no measured figure for how many decisions rest on incomplete or one sided information, so the share is an assumed value; the solution is the Delphi method, a structured and anonymised consultation over several rounds with aggregated feedback.

words.name: information
words.description: message provided to the participant about the correct response

triples.name: biased information
triples.description: incomplete or one sided information used as the basis for political and social decisions (concept paper section 4)

triples.name: Delphi method
triples.description: structured, iterative and anonymised consultation of experts, in a real time variant used to let transparent consensus building set the direction instead of the emotional impulse (concept paper section 4)

sources.name: Linstone & Turoff (1975) Delphi method
